author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/44-mobile-app.md — REQ-2, AC-2 + decomposition PR 4.

## Surface
- Mobile module reusing `polaris-frontend/src/components/` (subject_header, history_timeline) but NOT (action_composer, network_panel).
- New mobile-specific route: `/mobile/incident/{id}` — deep-link target from push.
- Tauri command (or PWA route handler) that maps `polaris://incident/<id>` → app route.

## What renders (REQ-2)
- Subject identity (DID + handle)
- Severity badge
- Reporting summary (counts + categories, NO reporter identity per privacy)
- Pattern observations
- v1 case timeline (history actions)

## What does NOT render
- Action composer (Label / Takedown / etc.) — desktop only
- Network panel (the M2 NetworkPanel is dense; mobile screens aren't the right form factor)
- Free-text reasoning input (REQ for desktop only)

## Rust-quality notes
- Reuse `polaris-frontend/src/components/subject_header.rs` directly (it's already a small, focused component). Per rust-quality §9: reuse, don't fork.
- A new component for "reporting summary without reporter identity" — explicit, named, takes only the privacy-safe fields. Don't pass the full `Vec<Report>` and rely on the renderer to skip fields.
- Per rust-quality §2: the read-only case view takes the case-view DTO `&CaseView` by reference, not by value. The view function returns `impl IntoView` (Leptos pattern).
- The cold-start path (push tap → app launch → API fetch → render) must complete in <5s per AC-2. Profile with `instruments` (iOS) / Android Profiler. Key optimization: don't block on the WebSocket connection for live updates — fetch over HTTP, subscribe over WS asynchronously.

## External references
- Leptos islands / mobile layout patterns: https://book.leptos.dev/
- iOS cold-start optimization: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/improving-your-app-s-performance
- Existing case-view in-repo: `polaris-frontend/src/pages/case_view.rs`

## Acceptance (AC-2)
- [ ] Tap push → app cold-starts → relevant incident case view renders within 5s.
- [ ] No action-composer UI visible.
- [ ] No reporter identities visible.

## Blocks / blocked-by
- Blocked by #117.
- Blocks #119 (take/release ownership operates on the rendered incident).
